description: This file implements Wayland protocol extensions for Virtio GPU surface metadata, including functions to set scanout IDs, retrieve surface metadata, and bind the interface to a Wayland display.

methods.name: virtio_gpu_surface_metadata_set_scanout_id
methods.description: Sets the scanout ID for a given surface metadata resource.

methods.name: destroy_virtio_gpu_surface_metadata_resource_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon surface metadata resource destruction, no operation performed.

methods.name: virtio_gpu_metadata_get_surface_metadata
methods.description: Handles request to get surface metadata, creates and sets implementation for the surface metadata resource.

methods.name: destroy_virtio_gpu_metadata_resource_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon surface metadata resource destruction, no operation performed.

methods.name: bind_virtio_gpu_metadata
methods.description: Binds the Virtio GPU metadata interface to a Wayland client.

methods.name: BindVirtioGpuMetadataInterface
methods.description: Binds the Virtio GPU metadata interface to the Wayland display, making it available to clients.
